data.name: Life Overhaul
data.detailed_description:
Roadmap

🚀 Life Overhaul Roadmap: The Ultimate Fun-Filled Preview!

🟢 What You Can Do Right Now (And Have a Laugh Doing It)

🏠 Housing & Decorating:

Right now, you can grab yourself a cozy little house and deck it out with furniture. It’s like playing interior designer without any of the stress. Just toss a couch here, a lamp there, and voilà—home sweet home!

🚗 Car Building:

Right now, car building is as easy as playing with toy blocks. Pop on a motor, slap on some tires, and off you go! No engineering degree required—just a sense of adventure and maybe a tiny bit of imagination.

📦 Jobs & Time Economy:

We’ve got some super simple delivery jobs. You pick up stuff, drop it off, and earn in-game time as currency. It’s like being a time-traveling courier without any of the time paradoxes. Plus, you can grab some food and clothes along the way—no realism overload here, just pure sandbox fun.

🔮 What’s Coming Next (And Why You Should Be Excited)

🏠 Advanced Building:

Soon, you’ll get to play architect and build houses from scratch. Walls, wiring, and all that jazz—except it’s still all about having a blast. If you want to build a house that looks like a giant shoe, go for it!

🚙 Vehicle Overhaul:

We’re talking more cars, more customization, and a whole lot of wacky tuning options. Want a neon pink monster truck or a car that shoots confetti? It’s all about creativity and fun.

🏁 Weekend Event Hub:

Coming soon, we’re hosting weekend car meets where you can show off your rides, trade parts, and basically turn the parking lot into a party. Think of it as a virtual hangout for car lovers.

🎰 Casino & Leisure:

We’re adding a casino map with blackjack, slots, and other games. Roll the dice, spin the wheel, and see if luck’s on your side. Just remember, what happens in the virtual casino stays in the virtual casino.

⏳ Time-Based Permadeath:

Yup, when your time’s up, you’re starting fresh. It’s a little like a game of tag with Father Time. But hey, that just means more chances to try something new next round.

🛒 NPCs & Shops:

NPCs will give you quests, drive cars, and maybe even help you run your own shop. It’s like having a bunch of quirky neighbors who occasionally need your help or just want to hang out.

🎨 Painting & Custom Designs:

And finally, get ready to unleash your inner artist. You can paint on anything—yes, even your friend’s car if they stand still long enough. Design your own liveries, trade them with others, and basically turn the world into your canvas. Just try not to start a paint war… or do, we won’t judge!

Note: As this is an early version of the game, you may encounter some bugs or unfinished features. We appreciate your understanding and welcome your feedback as we continue to improve and expand. Thank you for being part of our development journey!


About the Game














Note: As this is an early version of the game, you may encounter some bugs or unfinished features. We appreciate your understanding and welcome your feedback as we continue to improve and expand. Thank you for being part of our development journey!




Build, create, and live the garage life.
This game lets you design and build your own vehicles, trailers, and more from the ground up. Customize every detail, decorate your home, rent or sell property, and make your mark in an open world that grows with the community.

Whether you’re tuning engines, hauling parts, or just relaxing at home, everything you build is yours. Host your own server, invite your friends, or keep it private it’s your world to shape.

Early Access Roadmap

At launch, the focus is on the foundation:

  • Vehicle building and customization

  • Trailer construction

  • House decoration and property management

  • Multiplayer hosting and server settings

As the game evolves over the next few months, expect regular updates introducing:

  • Car meets and player gatherings

  • Jobs and player-driven economy

  • House building and landscaping

  • Maintenance work and world upgrades

  • More detailed tuning and customization systems

A Note from the Developer

I’m a single developer working full time, building this game in my spare hours because I’ve never found the game I wanted to play after work so I decided to make it myself.
This project is driven by passion and player feedback. The goal is to grow it together with the community, shaping it into something that everyone who loves cars, building, and creativity can enjoy.

Your ideas and feedback will help guide where this game goes next.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core processor (Ryzen 3 3100 OR core i5 7400)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD [R9 290] OR Nvidia [gtx 970]
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built in sound card
  • VR Support: no
  • Additional Notes: running the game with playable frame rates!
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: hex-core processor AMD[Ryzen 5 3600] Intel [Core i5-9600K]
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia gtx 1660 6gb OR AMD rx580 8gb
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built in sound card
  • VR Support: no
  • Additional Notes: running the game much more smoothly with higher fps!
